_comment: How each test binary is invoked. The default is --selftest; a test that takes a positional argument instead declares its own argv here. Without this, the runner's blanket --selftest would be read as a filename (native_expert_parity did exactly that and aborted).

native_expert_parity.note: argv[1] is a GGUF shard path. With no arguments it prints usage and exits 2, which is the honest 'missing input' signature declared in unavailable.json.

iq_parity.note: argv[1] is the fixture directory. Nothing else in the suite takes an argument.
